headlines.headline: Ja Morant out at least four weeks with grade 2 hamstring strain in first game back against Memphis
headlines.detail: The Trail Blazers guard was hurt in his first matchup against his former team since the offseason trade, with Portland ruling him out roughly 15 games as he's re-evaluated in four weeks.

headlines.headline: Colts open door to trading Jonathan Taylor as Seahawks join a crowded field of suitors ahead of Nov. 10 deadline
headlines.detail: Seattle, Washington, New Orleans, Denver and Minnesota have all checked in with Indianapolis on the All-Pro running back, who signed a two-year, $44 million extension in August and hasn't requested a trade.

headlines.headline: True freshman Luke Fahey makes first start for No. 2 Ohio State tonight at USC with Julian Sayin sidelined
headlines.detail: Ohio State is roughly a 6.5-point favorite in L.A. despite the change at QB, in a pivotal weekend for the playoff picture that also includes No. 4 Indiana hosting Minnesota and Washington's trip to Nebraska.

headlines.headline: Florida opens season Monday as No. 1 for first time since 2006, earning 47 of 59 first-place votes
headlines.detail: The Gators topped Duke and Illinois in the preseason AP Top 25 and tip off Monday at 6 p.m. ET against Miami in Tampa; reigning champion Michigan starts at No. 16 after Dusty May's departure for SMU.
